jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Alburgh School District, a town school district in the Grand Isle Supervisory Union (member town: Alburgh).
Alburgh Community Education Center (official school website); board documents are posted through the Grand Isle Supervisory Union.

sources.note: Alburgh Town School District official ballot, March 5, 2024 (posted by the Town of Alburgh): separate single-seat SCHOOL DIRECTOR races by term length, each voted by the whole town electorate -- the board is five directors elected at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(b) size). The 2024 winners were Luke Richter and Jennifer Fenn.

Alburgh School Board minutes in the Grand Isle Supervisory Union packet for May 20, 2024: the board sits as Whitney Maxham (Chair), Jennifer Fenn (Vice-Chair), Luke Richter (Clerk), Cheryl Dunn and Heather Darby.
